profile.headline: Information Technology
profile.summary: I am originally from India and moved to this country in 2003 and landed to Nashville. I have received my Bachelors in Public Health Education from Middle Tennessee State University and Masters in Healthcare Administration from Western Kentucky University. I enjoyed learning new things. I am innovative, dedicated worker and easy going person. After few years of managing and working in Assisted living facility, I decided to make career change. Technology is one of the evolving field and my interest towards knowing how the web page works lead me  to learn coding language. After researching careers in to technology field and guidance from my relative, I started to learn coding languages through online materials. Meanwhile, I heard about NSS and applied for the Part time boot camp program and luckily I was accepted for the program.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: GitHub · ASP.NET · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Attention to Detail · Data Analysis · Application Development · Microsoft SQL Server · HL7 Standards · C# · SQL

positions.title: Associate Engineer
positions.description:
Developed measure logic for Merit-Based Incentive Payment System(MIPS), InterMountain Reported Outcome Measures(IROMS) and CCOME care quality initiatives. 

Trained and mentored new colleagues.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Created individual and group  projects using HTML, CSS, Javascript and Jquery 
• Utilizing Github source code version control for all projects
• Written projects practicing JavaScript fundamentals leveraging DRY modular, readable code and reusable components 
• Created To Do application and Lego builder application using task automation with Webpack 
• Utilized Linting with EsLint and module bundling 
• Developed and contributed in group projects using REACT framework and deployed through firebase
• Practiced unit testing TDD in C# 
• Created WebAPI for ClinkedIn project using C# and ASP.Net using agile/scrum methodology 
• Created and modified database design/content using SQL, ADO.NET and dapper with migrations

positions.title: Assistant Administrator
positions.description:
• Responsible for managing 30+ employees including staff recruitment, selection, hiring and leading staff orientation 
• Managed employee time sheets and overtime using ADP software
• Conducted and lead the hospitality training for the employees
• Led  tours of facility and educating on facility services to visitors 
• Assisted administrator with admitting and evaluating residents for the facility 
• Acted as liaison for conflict resolution between staff, residents, and family members
• Maintained accurate accounting of patient trust funds including monthly reconciliation quarterly statements to responsible parties
• Tracked maintenance of facilities and physical assets, from preventative maintenance to scheduled maintenance to emergency repairs

positions.title: Residential Manager
positions.description:
• Responsible for management of about 20 direct care support staff including recruitment, selection, evaluation and continuous training  
• Collaborated with agency nurse to train staff on administration of medication for the residents.
• Reviewed and updated medication chart on monthly basis 
• Designed, implemented and evaluated overall plan of service for individuals with developmental disabilities in residential program
• Monitor individual appointments and activities, facility maintenance and management of individuals’ personal fund accounts 
• Assisted the behavioral specialist with the creation of behavior and resident centered plans, and documented and monitored daily plan
